en: A person who uses or controls a machine; or a person who works at a telephone exchange; or a person who runs a business.
ex: The operator connected my call to the manager.
接線員把我的電話轉給了經理。

en: What you think about something; or a judgment that is not based on facts alone; or an expert's advice.
ex: In my opinion, the movie was too long.
依我看，這部電影太長了。

en: A part of the body that has a particular job, such as the heart or liver; or a large musical instrument with pipes and keys.
ex: The heart is one of the most important organs in the body.
心臟是身體最重要的器官之一。

en: A group of people who work together for a purpose; or the way in which something is arranged or planned.
ex: She works for a large international organization.
她在一個大型國際組織工作。

en: A person who has something that belongs to them, especially a house or a business.
ex: The owner of the shop greeted every customer with a smile.
店主微笑著迎接每一位顧客。

en: A feeling of hurt in your body; or emotional unhappiness; or to cause someone to feel hurt.
ex: He had a sharp pain in his stomach after eating.
他吃完東西後胃部劇烈疼痛。

en: A picture made using paint; or the activity of making pictures with paint; or the act of covering with paint.
ex: The museum has a famous painting by Van Gogh.
博物館有一幅梵谷的名畫。

en: Loose trousers and a top that you wear in bed.
ex: The children put on their pajamas and went to bed.
孩子們穿上睡衣上床睡覺。

en: Having a skin color that is lighter than usual, because of illness or fear; or not bright in color.
ex: Her face turned pale when she heard the bad news.
她聽到壞消息時，臉色變得蒼白。

en: A flat metal container with a handle, used for cooking food; or to criticize something strongly; or to move a camera across a scene.
ex: She heated some oil in the pan and fried the eggs.
她在平底鍋裡加熱了一些油來煎蛋。

en: A large, sweet tropical fruit with orange flesh and many black seeds inside.
ex: She had papaya and yogurt for breakfast.
她早餐吃了木瓜配優格。

en: The act of forgiving someone; or an official decision to forgive a person for a crime; or to forgive someone for a mistake.
ex: Pardon me, could you repeat that more slowly?
對不起，你能說慢一點再說一次嗎？

en: To take part in an activity or event.
ex: All students are encouraged to participate in the school sports day.
學校鼓勵所有學生參加運動會。

en: Relating to one specific thing and not others; or very careful about choosing things; or a small detail.
ex: Is there any particular food you would like for dinner?
你晚餐有特別想吃什麼嗎？

en: A repeated design on a surface; or a regular way in which something happens or is done; or a model for making something.
ex: The curtains have a pattern of small blue flowers.
這窗簾上有藍色小花的圖案。

en: A state of freedom from war; or a calm and quiet situation; or a situation where there is no fighting.
ex: Everyone hopes for peace in the world.
每個人都期盼世界和平。

en: Calm and quiet, without trouble or noise; or not involving war or fighting.
ex: The village is a peaceful place, far from the noisy city.
這座村莊遠離喧鬧的城市，是個平靜的地方。

en: A round, soft fruit with sweet yellow-orange flesh and a fuzzy skin; or the tree that produces it.
ex: She picked a ripe peach from the tree.
她從樹上摘了一顆熟桃子。

en: A sweet fruit that is wide at the bottom and narrow at the top, with green or yellow skin.
ex: She ate a juicy pear for dessert.
她吃了一顆多汁的梨子當甜點。

en: Having no mistakes or faults; or the best that something can be; or to make something as good as possible.
ex: The weather was perfect for a day at the beach.
那天的天氣非常適合去海邊玩一天。

en: A length of time; or a class in school; or a historical time; or a punctuation mark showing the end of a sentence.
ex: We have an English class in the first period.
我們第一節課是英語課。

en: Relating to one particular person; or private and not for others; or done by a person rather than a representative.
ex: Please do not ask me such personal questions.
請別問我這麼私人的問題。

en: The way a person thinks, feels and behaves; or a famous person.
ex: She has a warm, friendly personality and makes friends easily.
她個性溫暖友善，很容易交到朋友。

en: A group of words that are used together and have a particular meaning; or a short way of saying something; or a short part of a tune.
ex: The phrase "break a leg" means good luck.
「break a leg」這個片語的意思是祝你好運。

en: A flat, round Italian food made of bread dough baked with cheese, tomatoes and other toppings.
ex: We ordered a large pizza with cheese and mushrooms.
我們點了一個加起司和蘑菇的大披薩。

en: Simple and not decorated; or clear and easy to understand; or a large area of flat land.
ex: She likes to wear plain clothes without any decoration.
她喜歡穿沒有任何裝飾的素色衣服。

en: An outdoor area where children can play, often with equipment such as swings and slides.
ex: The children are playing on the swings in the playground.
孩子們在遊樂場玩鞦韆。

en: Nice, enjoyable or friendly; or giving you pleasure.
ex: We spent a pleasant afternoon walking by the river.
我們在河邊散步度過了愉快的下午。

en: Used to show that one number or amount is added to another; or an advantage or benefit; or also.
ex: Two plus three equals five.
二加三等於五。

en: A person who writes poems.
ex: The poet wrote a beautiful poem about the sea.
那位詩人寫了一首關於大海的美麗詩篇。

en: Poems in general; or the art of writing poems; or very beautiful or moving language.
ex: She likes to read poetry before going to bed.
她喜歡睡前讀詩。

en: A substance that can cause death or serious illness if eaten or drunk; or to give poison to someone; or to spoil something.
ex: Some mushrooms contain poison and should not be eaten.
有些蘑菇含有毒素，不能吃。

en: A man who is a member of the police force.
ex: The policeman helped the lost boy find his mother.
警察幫迷路的男孩找到了他的媽媽。

en: The meat from a pig, eaten fresh or preserved as ham or bacon.
ex: We had roast pork with rice for dinner.
我們晚餐吃了烤豬肉配飯。

en: A town or city with a harbor where ships can load and unload; or the left side of a ship; or a socket on a computer.
ex: The ship arrived at the port early in the morning.
那艘船一大早抵達港口。

en: The place where something is, or how it is arranged; or a job; or a point of view; or to put something in a particular place.
ex: She applied for a position as a teacher at the school.
她應徵了這所學校的教師職位。

en: Hopeful and confident; or sure about something; or showing that something is good or true; or greater than zero.
ex: She has a positive attitude toward life.
她對生活抱持積極的態度。

en: A chance that something might happen or be true; or something that might happen.
ex: There is a possibility that it will snow tomorrow.
明天有可能會下雪。

en: The system of sending letters and parcels; or a strong stick fixed in the ground; or a job; or to put information online or send by mail.
ex: I will post this letter on my way to school.
我在上學的路上會把這封信寄出去。

en: A card that you write on and send to someone by post without an envelope, usually with a picture on one side.
ex: She sent a postcard to her friend from Paris.
她從巴黎寄了一張明信片給朋友。
